# Headway

> Headway Ag LLC (Stuart, Florida, USA) builds solar ear tags that hold a virtual fence for cattle, watch every animal and detect lightning, and a ranch app with no subscription for grazing plans, herd records, money and farm tax forms. Tags are in testing. Patent pending. Contact: hughheadwayag@gmail.com

## Key facts

- Company: Headway Ag LLC, Stuart, Florida, USA
- Product: Solar ear tags for virtual fencing of cattle, and a ranch app with no subscription
- Livestock: Cattle, beef and dairy
- Worn as: An ear tag, not a neck collar
- Power: Solar, charged every day on the ear
- Cue: Sound first. A mild stimulus only as the last step, with hard limits
- Also does: Guiding and splitting the herd, automatic weight records with a walk-over scale, lightning detection, theft and no movement alerts, track replay
- Records: Tagged at birth, full life history, health and genetics, read in the field by phone tap
- App: Live map, grazing planner, herd records, money and farm tax forms. No subscription
- Status: Tags in testing. Patent pending
- Contact: hughheadwayag@gmail.com

## Home

- [Headway: virtual fencing ear tags and a ranch app](https://headwayfence.com/): Solar ear tags that hold a virtual fence for cattle, watch every animal and detect lightning, plus a ranch app with no subscription.

## Virtual fencing

- [How virtual fencing for cattle works | Headway](https://headwayfence.com/virtual-fencing/): Draw a virtual fence on a map, send it to solar ear tags, and cattle learn the line from a tone. Breaks, keep-out zones and strip grazing, explained.
- [Strip grazing and breaks with virtual fencing | Headway](https://headwayfence.com/virtual-fencing/breaks.html): Make grazing breaks from templates, see feed per head and grazing days, and move cattle between breaks from the Headway app with no temporary fence.
- [Keep-out zones for cattle: creeks, yards, pivots | Headway](https://headwayfence.com/virtual-fencing/keep-out-zones.html): Draw keep-out zones inside a paddock to keep cattle off creek banks, the house yard and pivot towers with a virtual fence instead of posts and wire.
- [Guide, split and move cattle with virtual fencing | Headway](https://headwayfence.com/virtual-fencing/herding.html): Walk a mob down a moving virtual lane to new ground, split calves or steers into their own mob, and move cattle on a schedule from the Headway app.
- [Virtual fencing and animal welfare | Headway](https://headwayfence.com/virtual-fencing/welfare.html): Headway tags use sound first and a mild stimulus only as a last step, with hard limits, no cues while running or walking back, and alerts instead.
- [How to choose a virtual fence for cattle | Headway](https://headwayfence.com/virtual-fencing/choosing.html): Questions to ask any virtual fencing company before you buy: cost per head, cloudy weather, no signal, keep-out zones, welfare, and how Headway answers.

## The ear tag

- [Solar cattle ear tag: GPS, behaviour, alerts | Headway](https://headwayfence.com/ear-tag/): A solar ear tag for cattle that tracks GPS position, grazing and resting, animals off the herd, theft and lightning, with no neck collar to catch on a fence.
- [Automatic cattle weight records | Headway](https://headwayfence.com/ear-tag/weighing.html): The tag does not weigh. It works with a walk-over scale at the water lane, so each weight is saved to the right animal on the days you pick.
- [Tap a tag: cattle records in the field | Headway](https://headwayfence.com/ear-tag/tap-a-tag.html): Hold a phone to a Headway ear tag to open that animal's record in the field, even with no signal. Vets see treatments, withdrawal dates and history.
- [Lightning detection for cattle | Headway ear tags](https://headwayfence.com/ear-tag/lightning.html): Headway ear tags detect lightning near the herd, tell you how far away it is and if it is getting closer, and let you move cattle to safer ground in one tap.
- [Solar powered ear tag for cattle | Headway](https://headwayfence.com/ear-tag/solar.html): Headway ear tags are charged by the sun every day, sealed for outdoor life, and look after their own battery so the virtual fence holds in cloudy weather.
- [Virtual fencing with no cell signal | Headway](https://headwayfence.com/ear-tag/coverage.html): How Headway works in ranch dead spots: grazing plans stored on every tag, a low-data app mode, and a herd link and yard base station in development.

## The app

- [Ranch management app with no subscription | Headway](https://headwayfence.com/software/): A ranch app with no subscription: live GPS map of every animal, virtual fence breaks, mob moves, heat and rest maps, herd records, money and tax.
- [Auto grazing and seasonal grazing planner | Headway](https://headwayfence.com/software/grazing.html): Plan which mob grazes where and when, move the herd automatically on schedule, and compare the plan to actual grazing with stocking rate and feed demand.
- [Cattle health, genetics and lifetime records | Headway](https://headwayfence.com/software/records.html): Tag calves at birth and keep each animal's full history in the Headway app: weights, dam and sire, genetics, vaccines, treatments and withdrawal dates.
- [Ranch cash flow and financial planning | Headway](https://headwayfence.com/software/money.html): Holistic financial planning for ranches: a monthly cash plan against actuals, expenses in 3 taps, and every entry ready for your farm tax form.
- [Farm tax forms filled in for 12 countries | Headway](https://headwayfence.com/software/tax.html): The Headway app fills in farm tax forms as you go: Schedule F, T2042, SA103F, IR3F, P8 and more, plus a plain income and expense pack anywhere.
- [No subscription ranch software | Headway Ag LLC](https://headwayfence.com/software/license.html): The Headway ranch app has no subscription and is licensed under the Headway Software License. Headway Ag LLC owns it. Your farm data stays yours.
